hero_layout: minimal — just name and title, lots of whitespace
hero_height: auto — natural content height, no forced height
nav_style: side dots — floating dot indicators on the side
card_style: terminal window styled cards (title bar with dots)
scroll_animation: moderate — staggered entrance of cards and elements
hover_effects: subtle — slight lift or color shift on cards
contact_style: playful — with a friendly CTA headline
border_radius: pill — fully rounded on small elements
color_scheme: mixed — alternating dark and light sections
quirk: entire page has a subtle paper/grain texture overlay
bonus_quirk: add a subtle scanline/CRT effect over the hero section
